---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea
title: "[feat] "
labels: enhancement
---

**The idea**
What would you like SYSCORE to do?

**Why**
The problem it solves / who it helps.

**Keep it lean**
SYSCORE ships with zero third-party dependencies. If your idea needs an external
library, suggest how it might be done with the Windows/MinGW system APIs instead.
